description: Owner ruling D-11 (editing the business profile is OWNER only, regardless of granted scopes) holds on the two sibling routes of PATCH /identity/businesses/:businessId that R0-09's review named (R09-ST-2 presence slug, R09-ST-3 concierge auto-configure) and on the concierge chat intake beside them (R0-09b review SEC-2). R0-09d-D11-GENESIS-TEMPLATES extends this manifest with the last two siblings R0-09b review SEC-1 found (suite d11-genesis-templates.integration.test.ts, cases D11G-*): POST /business-genesis/businesses/:businessId/answers refuses a non-owner any submission carrying businessName, currency, country or businessIntent as a string (the answers it copies onto Business.name, currency, country, businessIntent): 403 {code:'BUSINESS_PROFILE_OWNER_ONLY'}, Business row byte-identical, no blueprint inference; answers carrying none of them (the legal disclaimer acceptance, blueprint-only answers) keep the BusinessGuard rule (any member). POST /businesses/:businessId/templates/:templateId/apply is OWNER only as a whole (it writes Business.industry and archetype and records the setup template in business_template_usages, besides creating the template's products, services and expense categories): 403 {code:'BUSINESS_PROFILE_OWNER_ONLY'} before the template is read, Business row byte-identical, nothing else written. PUT /site/presence/businesses/:businessId/draft refuses a non-owner a slug that is neither Business.slug nor the draft's own: 403 {code:'PRESENCE_SLUG_OWNER_ONLY'}, nothing written. POST .../publish never moves Business.slug for a non-owner: when the draft's slug differs (a slug the owner saved and has not published, or one left behind when the owner moved Business.slug through the PATCH, review CR-1), the page goes live at the current Business.slug, the Business row is byte-identical and the draft keeps its slug for the owner's publish; a publish that keeps the slug does not rewrite the Business row; other presence edits keep the BusinessGuard rule (any member). POST /onboarding-concierge/businesses/:businessId/auto-configure is OWNER only as a whole (every call writes the setup configuration into Business.metaData; it also writes name, businessHours, storeEnabled and a missing slug): 403 {code:'BUSINESS_PROFILE_OWNER_ONLY'}, Business row byte-identical, no product created. POST .../chat answers any member, but only the owner's answers are persisted (businessIntent, industry, archetype, country, blueprint inference); a non-owner's chat leaves the Business row byte-identical. The owner (OWNER membership or Business.ownerId, the rule IdentityService.assertBusinessOwner applies) and SUPER_ADMIN (the BusinessGuard platform bypass) still succeed. Run from apps/server against this packet's isolated, migrated database (all four files in one report): npx vitest run test/d11-sibling-writes.integration.test.ts test/d11-genesis-templates.integration.test.ts test/d11-finance-settings.integration.test.ts src/core/config/d11-owner-writes.spec.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-09f-vitest.json, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/d11-sibling-writes.json --report .proof/r0-09f-vitest.json. Cases tagged RED-BEFORE fail on the unmodified code (the R0 working branch at a230d7fc): the review-repair suite there fails 9 of 19 (S01, S02, S03, S04, S09, C01, C02, C03, C07), 10 pass and 1 is todo; on the first packet head a89f14bc it fails 4 (S02, S03, S09: a stale or pending draft slug answered 403 to a non-owner's content publish; C07: a non-owner's chat persisted intake). The tests-first commit 03329b28 recorded the original 15-case tally: 7 failed, 8 passed. R0-09d: on the R0 working branch at 77f3aabf (before the R0-09d fix) the new suite fails 6 of 14 (D11G-G01, G02, G03, T01, T02, T03) and 8 pass; the tests-first commit ce6285e8 records that tally. The R0-09d review repair (SEC-T1) adds D11G-G09 and T06 (a STAFF member who owns another business, bizO) and one it.todo: on the pre-fix source (ce6285e8) the suite then fails 8 of 16 (the six above plus G09, T06), 8 pass and 1 is todo; at the packet head with the owner lookup unbound from the route's business (`where: { ownerId: actor.id }`, or an OWNER membership looked up in any business) G09 and T06 fail and the other 14 pass. R0-09f-D11-FINANCE-TAX-AND-WEB extends this manifest with the last writer R0-09d's sweep found open and a static guard (suites d11-finance-settings.integration.test.ts, cases D11F-*, and src/core/config/d11-owner-writes.spec.ts, cases D11W-*): PATCH /finance/businesses/:businessId/settings refuses a non-owner (STAFF on defaults, ADMIN on defaults, ADMIN with settings:write, a STAFF who owns another business, also with the header, query and body naming that business) any submission that CHANGES Business.defaultTaxRate: 403 {code:'BUSINESS_PROFILE_OWNER_ONLY'}, Business row byte-identical, nothing of the submission written; the route's other settings (accountingBasis, fiscalYearStartMonth, defaultCashAccountId, defaultArAccountId, defaultApAccountId, defaultTaxAccountId, accountantEmail) are not owner-only and keep ensureAccess (any member), and a non-owner's whole-form save that resubmits the current rate goes through with the rate not written (a stored NULL stays NULL). The owner (OWNER membership, Business.ownerId) and a SUPER_ADMIN holding a membership change it; a SUPER_ADMIN with no membership is still refused by ensureAccess (pinned, not widened). The static spec reads every business.update/updateMany/upsert in apps/server/src (typescript AST), requires every writer of an owner-only field (UpdateBusinessDto except metaData, plus archetype, onboardingComplete, onboardingCompletedAt and the setup keys of metaData) or of data it cannot see into to be allow-listed with exactly those fields, requires every owner-guarded writer to be reached only through one of its named owner checks on every resolved call path, and requires each named check to apply the owner rule. On the R0 working branch at 8286a7a9 (before the R0-09f fix) the finance suite fails 5 of 12 (D11F-F01, F02, F03, F04, F11) and 7 pass, and the static spec fails 2 of 6 (D11W-03: the path FinanceSettingsService.update <- FinanceController.patchSettings has no owner check; D11W-04: assertTaxRateOwner does not exist) and 4 pass; the tests-first commit 57e3025a records that tally. R0-09g-D11-DOCUMENT-TEMPLATES extends this manifest with the last writer the R0-09f static sweep pinned as open (suite d11-sibling-writes.integration.test.ts, cases D11-D*, and the static spec, case D11W-08): PATCH /commerce/businesses/:businessId/document-templates writes Business.invoiceTemplate and quoteTemplate (UpdateBusinessDto fields), and every value it accepts is one of them, so it is OWNER only as a whole: a non-owner (STAFF on defaults with revenue:read, STAFF granted every scope admin, ADMIN on defaults, ADMIN with settings:write) is refused 403 {code:'BUSINESS_PROFILE_OWNER_ONLY'} with the Business row byte-identical, whatever fields the body carries (an empty body included). The owner by either arm (the OWNER membership, or Business.ownerId with no membership row, whom the route's revenue:write ModuleScopeGuard used to refuse) and a SUPER_ADMIN set the templates; GET .../document-templates stays open to every member (revenue:read included); a foreign or unknown business id writes nothing (BusinessGuard 403). The handler runs FinanceSettingsService.isProfileOwner (the R0-09f owner test) before anything is read or written. On the R0 working branch at 61baa48d (before the R0-09g fix) the D11-D block fails 4 of 8 (D01, D02, D03, D07) and 4 pass (D04, D05, D06, D08), and the static spec fails 2 of 8 (D11W-03: the path CommerceController.setDocumentTemplate has no owner check; D11W-08: its write at line 515 follows no isProfileOwner call) and 6 pass; the tests-first commit records that tally.
notes: Owner-only fields are the ones PATCH /identity/businesses/:businessId writes (R0-09): name, slug, currency, timezone, tax, store settings, businessHours, businessIntent, industry, archetype, country, the configuration kept in metaData and the rest of UpdateBusinessDto. The presence routes put only slug on the Business row; branding, sections, seo and customDomain live in site_page_drafts / site_pages_published, so those edits were not tightened (cases S04, S05).

Business.metaData is not owner-only as a bag (review CR-2): the concierge's display-state keys (conciergeDismissed, conciergeDismissedAt from dismiss/resume, snoozedNudges from snooze, nudgeHistory from GET nudges) are fixed keys with server-chosen values that carry no profile content, and the command-center nudges widget calls snooze for every member, so those routes keep the BusinessGuard rule; case C09 pins that they change only those keys. Auto-configure is refused as a whole because it writes setup configuration (conciergeTemplateId, conciergeSetupAt, setup milestones, paymentMethodsConfigured, paymentRecommendations) besides the profile columns (case C02).

The owner rule is restated in PresenceService.isSlugOwner and OnboardingConciergeService.isProfileOwner rather than imported from IdentityService, as R0-08c did: IdentityModule imports AiModule, which reaches SiteModule through KeyCortexModule, and neither feature module file is in this packet's write set.

allowAdditionalCases is true for one it.todo in this suite, not a required case: R0-09b presence draft and publish cannot change Business.slug for a non-owner (D-11, review R09-ST-2) REQUIRED (follow-up; identity.service.ts updateBusiness — outside the R0-09b write set; review CR-1, already true before R0-09b): when the OWNER moves Business.slug through PATCH /identity/businesses/:id, a draft still carrying the old slug follows it, so the owner's next presence publish does not put the old slug back on Business.slug (the draft cannot tell a stale slug from a pending one) The owner's own publish of a draft that still carries a slug from before the owner's PATCH puts that old slug back on Business.slug; this was already true before R0-09b, the draft cannot tell a stale slug from a pending one, and the fix (the PATCH moving the draft's slug with Business.slug) is in identity.service.ts, outside this write set.
